name: Transmat
ownershipStory: May founded Transmat in 1986 to release his own Rhythim Is Rhythim material, starting with "Nude Photo." The label went on to release early work by Carl Craig (as Psyche), Suburban Knight, and other second-wave Detroit and Chicago-adjacent producers.
hook: The label Derrick May built to release "Strings of Life," and kept going as a launching pad for the next generation.

blurb.age7: Derrick May started his own label, Transmat, to put out his own songs, including "Strings of Life."
blurb.age13: May founded Transmat in 1986, following Juan Atkins' example with Metroplex. It released his own Rhythim Is Rhythim records and later helped launch other Detroit-area producers like Carl Craig.
blurb.adult: Transmat follows the artist-owned pattern Metroplex set, and its catalogue beyond May's own work (particularly early Carl Craig releases) makes it one of the clearest through-lines from first-wave to second-wave Detroit techno.
